subject_rule: UBC does not limit the field of study: the scholarship considers the applicant's first-choice programme at UBC Vancouver (including Vantage College) or UBC Okanagan, and only these degrees are "not eligible": Bachelor of Nursing (Okanagan and Vancouver), Bachelor of Dental Science in Dental Hygiene, Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science, Bachelor + Master of Management, dual degrees, joint degrees between UBC Okanagan and UBC Vancouver, and joint degrees with other post-secondary institutions.
